project.objective: Establish the origins of Elizabeth Young née Martin (m. Thomas Young, 16 November 1828, St James, Bristol, Gloucestershire) — her christening and her parents

questions.question: Where and when was Elizabeth Martin, wife of Thomas Young, christened?
questions.rationale: Her marriage in 1828 and her maiden surname Martin are established; her christening would fix her birth year and name her parents.

items.rationale: A Gloucestershire parish christening in the years before 1815 would name her parents. She married in Bristol in 1828 and was described as of full age, so a christening in the 1808-1815 window is expected.
